name: plain-sonnet-s1-dev-r1-answer_audit_log_key-amplifier-plain-a1
final_message:
I read all files: README.md (the question), config.py (`AUDIT_PREFIX = "AUD"`), audit.py (the sole audit-log writer, defining `_format_key(kind, ident) -> f"{AUDIT_PREFIX}-{kind.upper()}-{ident}"` and calling it to build `key` before `log[key] = True`), decoy_cache.py and decoy_metrics.py (red herrings using `METRICS_PREFIX = "MET"`, never touching the audit log), and service.py (`checkout(order_id)` calls `write_audit("order", order_id)`).

Tracing the only real audit-log write path: `service.checkout("7781")` → `write_audit("order", "7781")` → `key = [REDACTED:SECRET]"order", "7781")` = `f"{AUDIT_PREFIX}-{"order".upper()}-{"7781"}"` = `"AUD-ORDER-7781"`.

ANSWER: AUD-ORDER-7781
